_comment: Allowlist for the magic-strings checker (tools/conventions/check_magic_strings.py). Each entry documents a string literal that is legitimately NOT a magic value: framework-required literals, structural field-access names, route/mount paths, and CLI subcommand names. Entries are matched by file + literal (line-agnostic), so they survive unrelated edits. The 'line' field is documentation of the first known occurrence only.
